text: If your afternoon plans are outdoors, get them done early, because the wet stuff is building. Right now it's cloudy and mild, near 77, with a gusty south wind and enough humidity to feel sticky. Officially it's just a slight chance of a shower or storm into this afternoon, but the forecasters are watching this system closely, and the models lean wetter than the official 30 percent suggests, so I wouldn't be shocked by a stray rumble before the real action arrives tonight. That's when things get serious: showers and thunderstorms move in this evening and could turn heavy and slow moving, with an isolated flash flood risk overnight into Monday morning. If you're on the water, the Lake Wind Advisory is up with south winds 15 to 25 knots and 2 to 3 foot waves, so plan to be off the broad waters well before evening. Keep the rain gear handy through Monday, since another half inch or more is on the table before this front finally clears out.
